assetBaseUrl.base: build-provided asset base resolved against the admitted document base, never a fixed repository URL
assetBaseUrl.normalization: absolute URL with trailing directory slash; URL parse failures rejected before fetch

workerCount.autoRequestedCount: omitted means manifest preferred; explicit value must be 2..manifest max; effective ST fallback count is 1

order: game.init with synchronous PRE final selection
prepare.concurrentSameRuntimeScope: one shared preparation promise; conflicting normalized config rejects without replacing the in-flight operation
prepare.failedPromise: clear only after acquired resources are released and diagnostic receipt is retained; retry uses a new attempt generation
prepare.lateBackendSelection: reject after engine physics world exists

cleanup.ownership: one acquisition receipt per selected 2D/3D backend in the admitted app attempt
cleanup.twoDFailed: do not start 3D; release only resources actually acquired by 2D
cleanup.threeDFailed: release partial 3D acquisition and acquired 2D resources
cleanup.gameInitFailed: attempt both acquired backend cleanups even if one fails
cleanup.normalClose: engine/world/handles before module/pool; release each acquired backend once; repeated close idempotent
cleanup.lateAsyncCompletion: must self-release on generation invalidation; cannot publish native module or create world into another attempt

artifacts.integrityBoundary: Manifest and fetched WASM bytes are verified before instance creation. Loaded facade/core identity must match. A separately fetched loader hash is build/distribution consistency evidence, not a claim that JavaScript dynamic import has a browser SRI guarantee.

csp.browserAcceptance: actual served page with enforced response CSP, no COOP/COEP for ST; inspect network and security policy violations

packaging.version: derive prerelease from actual package baseline at pack time
packaging.packageEntry: one canonical main runtime containing selected feature
packaging.variantDeclarations: generate declarations for the same variant; do not copy default build:dts blindly because AIR_OUT_DIR is not inherited
consumers: ST core example set EX01-EX06 and EX09

implementationStatus: Wired into app-config/bootstrap/selector and optional ST feature/assets build path. No actual world adapter is registered yet, so explicit selection rejects before loading. Runtime bundle, variant declarations, tarball, browser/CSP and full application physics acceptance are not certified by these source changes.
